headline: Sustaining the growth momentum!

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Bharti Airtel (BHAAIR) CMP: ₹2055 Target ₹ 2400 (17%) Target Period: 12 months November 09, 2026 Sustaining the growth momentum!
India wireless revenues were up 3.4% QoQ (up 10.1% YoY) at ₹ 30943 crore, driven by Average Revenues per User (ARPU), which was at ₹ 271, 2.7% QoQ and up ~5.9% YoY.
It witnessed healthy 4G+5G Net adds of 2.9 mn during the quarter, with 4G/5G data subbase at 304.6 mn.
The post - paid subscriber base also saw robust addition of ~1.2 mn subscribers (highest ever in a quarter) at 31.2 mn.
